translations.web: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
translations.bsb: He who leads the upright along the path of evil will fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit what is good.
translations.kjv: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
translations.asv: Whoso causeth the upright to go astray in an evil way, He shall fall himself into his own pit; But the perfect shall inherit good.
